$databaseComment: LocalDB (Paddockside) is the default. The https-azure launch profile sets DatabaseConnection=PaddocksideAzureDev to use the Azure dev database, signing in as you through the Azure CLI (az login); no password is stored. Your public IP must be allowed in the SQL server firewall.

DevSeed.$comment: Development only. A local demo login against LocalDB, created on first run; enrol an authenticator app on first sign-in.
